reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Five-probability sweep plus iso-mean/iso-variance blocks, embedded timing/omission probes and mixed-unit/photometry recording.

checks.reason: No explicit commitment to consult/check prior primary Methods or a validated technical protocol for pre-execution settings and transfer is made; local calibration and preregistration alone do not meet M.

Core preparation/recording, delivery magnitude and behavioral acquisition settings lack a complete executable quantitative workflow or concrete calibration-to-setting procedure; listing parameters to freeze later is insufficient.
Timing, delivery, identity and stability checks lack numerical acceptance-to-action thresholds or a concrete derivation of tolerances before the main contrast.
Animal-level pilot variance and meaningful effect planning are present, but no numerical power or confidence-width target is specified for the confirmatory sample.
The hierarchical conceptual model does not specify a likelihood/dispersion decision with diagnostics and a concrete multiplicity procedure across the several primary comparisons.
Technical/training changes are not explicitly followed by a revised frozen analysis/protocol and fresh independent confirmation.
No complete raw-trial/unit manifest with exact analysis/acquisition versions/settings, calibration records and all technical/biological losses is specified.

checks.quote: On a minority (~10%) of p=1 and p=0.5 trials
checks.reason: Unsignaled timing shifts and omissions embedded in the supposedly certain fixed-time conditions change the learned timing/probability distribution. The primary analysis never excludes or models that contamination. Session exclusion for absent phasic signatures also selects on biological responses.

Two mathematical errors: a table labeled expected-value controlled predicts value-only firing rising with probability; p(1-p) is called variance/entropy even across varying magnitudes, although amount variance requires m^2 and entropy is a distinct function. Correct fixed-magnitude variance is written elsewhere but does not repair the cross-condition decision.
The packet reports diminished predicted-reward responses, not necessarily zero firing response; the opening inference upgrades this to fully predicted -> no response as reported framework.

Cross-validation has no held-out unit/block definition; optional photometry lacks a specified independent confirmation comparison. Neither provides an operational independent check of the fitted uncertainty claim.
